# Architecture Recommendation

**Deploy a self-contained, on-premises solution using a containerized stack (Docker/Kubernetes) with local LLM inference via Ollama or similar, coupled with a lightweight vector database (Milvus or Weaviate) and a REST API layer—all running within your network boundary with no external dependencies.** This approach satisfies the offline requirement while leveraging the team's deployment experience and ensuring maintainability through industry-standard containerization. Include local monitoring (Prometheus/Grafana) and version-controlled configuration management to support long-term operations.
